description: Change the state of a home device: turn lights, fans or locks on or off, dim lights, set the thermostat. Changes things in the house.
examples: Set the living room lights to 40 percent
Turn the bedroom fan to low
Make the bedroom lights warm white
Turn up the heat a couple of degrees
Turn on the fan in the nursery
negatives: Play some jazz in the kitchen
Create an automation that turns off the lights at midnight

profile.style: Before acting, call get_live_context to find the device the user means: match their words to a device's name or area (a 'den light' may be named 'Den Switch'). Then act with the device's exact name (and domain, e.g. light) rather than guessing an area, and never use a speaker or media device's area for a light. If it is already in the requested state, say so. If several devices match, act on the clear best match and say which. If nothing matches, name what you looked for and the closest devices. Say plainly what you did; never claim an action that errored. For a whole-room or whole-category request ('all the lights', 'all the fans'): the device may be a light/fan entity or a switch or plug wired to one. List the room's devices from get_live_context, pick every one that is that kind of device from its name, and switch each by its exact name; one area-wide call would miss the switches. Report how many you switched and name any that did not respond.
